title: 2 Days Tarangire, Maasai Village, Materuni Waterfall & Coffee Tour
description: This 2 days Tarangire, Materuni Waterfall & Coffee Tour offers a perfect blend of wildlife safari, cultural immersion, and nature exploration in northern Tanzania. Begin with exciting game drives in Tarangire National Park, famous for its large elephant herds and iconic baobab trees. On the second day, visit Materuni Village at the foothills of Mount Kilimanjaro, where you’ll enjoy a scenic waterfall hike and a hands-on traditional coffee tour, learning and tasting local Arabica coffee. This 2 Days Tarangire, Maasai Village, Materuni Waterfall & Coffee Tour is ideal for travelers seeking diverse experiences in limited time.
highlights: Game drive in Tarangire National Park, famous for large elephant herds
Scenic landscapes with ancient baobab trees
Authentic visit to a Maasai Village
Stunning views at the foothills of Mount Kilimanjaro
Professional guide and comfortable safari vehicle
excludes: Optional activities (e.g. hot air balloon safari )

itinerary.title: Arusha – Tarangire National Park – Maasai Village – Arusha
itinerary.text: After an early pick-up from your hotel in Arusha, drive to Tarangire National Park, one of Tanzania’s most scenic parks. Enjoy a guided game drive through savannah plains and along the Tarangire River, spotting elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, and abundant birdlife.Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the park before continuing your afternoon game drive. Later, visit a Maasai Village for an authentic cultural experience, where you’ll learn about Maasai traditions, lifestyle, crafts, and dances. In the evening, return to Arusha for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Materuni Waterfall & Coffee Tour – Kilimanjaro Airport
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart Arusha for Materuni Village, located on the lush slopes of Mount Kilimanjaro. Take a guided walk through local farmland and tropical forest to reach the beautiful Materuni Waterfall, one of the tallest waterfalls in the region.After the hike, enjoy a traditional coffee tour, learning how coffee is grown, harvested, roasted, and brewed by the local Chagga community. Enjoy lunch in the village with scenic views of Mount Kilimanjaro before transferring to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure.

summary: This 2 days Tarangire, Materuni Waterfall & Coffee Tour offers a perfect blend of wildlife safari, cultural immersion, and nature exploration in northern Tanzania.
